messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Which registration plate does the truck bear that carries the Effer hydraulic crane listed at position 7?

response.text: Quale targa di immatricolazione porta il camion che trasporta la gru idraulica Effer elencata alla posizione 7?
